senses.gloss: closing up, obstruction of orifices, v. עִיצּוּר.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:13">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 20:18">Gen. XX, 18</cite>) <he>נאמר ע׳ בפה ע׳ בגרון וכ׳</he> the root <he>עצר</he> applies to closure of the mouth, of the throat &c.—<he>עֲצִירַת גשמים</he> (v.
Deut. XI, 17) closing up the heavens so as to withhold the rain, drought.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 43">Sifré Deut. 43</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 867">Yalk. ib. 867</cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 151:1">Sifré Num. 151</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782:20">Yalk. ib. 782</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01136"><he>עצרת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 29:35">Num. XXIX, 35</cite>) <he>אין ע׳ אלא כניסה</he> the root <he>עצר</he> has the meaning of detention (by ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 36:5">Jer. XXXVI, 5</cite>).
